proposals.evidence: Turner’s gaṭṭa piece family includes Punjabi gaṭṭ/gaṭṭā and, explicitly in the addenda, Western Pahari gɔṭṭɔ and gaṭi small stone/pebble. The Awankari, Pothwari and Gujari stone responses match that northwestern lexical family. i-vowel giṭṭ- forms and responses combining different words are excluded.
